pd_sweeping_oath.name: Sweeping Oath
pd_sweeping_oath.desc: Melee sweep: windup 0.2 s, recovery 0.28 s, 5 s cooldown. Needs a shield and a live enemy within 2.4 m. Hits up to 4 enemies in a frontal 3.5 m arc for 16-22 flat Physical damage (no weapon or Attack Power scaling) and adds +1 Holy Power once, however many are hit. Carries threat bonus 45. It does not grant Oath of the Shield, so a following Shield Bash gets no bonus Holy Power. Trade-off: low damage per target and only 1 Holy Power; Oath Cut into Shield Bash stays the better single-target build.

pd_hallowed_verdict.name: Hallowed Verdict
pd_hallowed_verdict.desc: Committed finisher: windup 0.4 s, recovery 0.4 s, 10 s cooldown, spends 5 Holy Power (the full bar). Needs a shield and a live enemy within 3 m. Releases a 4.5 m burst around you that hits up to 5 enemies for 30-38 flat Light damage each and heals you for 5% of max Health. Carries threat bonus 60. Opportunity cost: it takes the whole bar, which is a Radiant Strike (3 Holy Power) plus 2 more; per Holy Power it only beats Radiant Strike against roughly 2 or more enemies.

pd_bastion_ward.name: Bastion Ward
pd_bastion_ward.desc: Off-GCD group defense, instant, 24 s cooldown, spends 2 Holy Power. Needs a shield. For 6 s, allies within 8 m take 10% less damage but move 12% slower. Opportunity cost: 2 Holy Power is two thirds of a Radiant Strike, and the slow makes repositioning harder during the window. It reduces damage only; it is not invulnerability.

pd_rebuke.name: Rebuke
pd_rebuke.desc: Off-GCD shield interrupt, instant, 12 s cooldown. Needs a shield and an enemy within 3 m. Interrupts the target's cast and locks it out for 3 s. It costs no Holy Power and generates none, so its only price is the cooldown and the need to stand in reach.

bk_reaping_cleave.name: Reaping Cleave
bk_reaping_cleave.desc: Melee cleave: windup 0.22 s, recovery 0.28 s, 4 s cooldown. Needs a live enemy within 2.4 m. Hits up to 5 enemies in a frontal 3.5 m arc for 16-22 flat Physical damage (no weapon scaling) and adds +8 Fury once. It neither uses nor consumes Flow, so Trade-off: it is a weaker Fury source than Rend Slash (+12 Fury, +6 more with Flow); pick it when 3 or more enemies stand in front of you.

bk_blood_cyclone.name: Blood Cyclone
bk_blood_cyclone.desc: Committed spender: windup 0.36 s, recovery 0.38 s, 10 s cooldown, spends 40 Fury. Needs a live enemy within 2.4 m. Spins for 30-38 flat Physical damage to up to 5 enemies within 4 m (no weapon scaling) and grants Flow for 5 s, so the next Rend Slash gets its bonus. Trade-off: it costs 10 more Fury than Bloodthirst and has no lifesteal, so it only beats Bloodthirst against about 2 or more enemies.

bk_grit.name: Gritted Teeth
bk_grit.desc: Off-GCD defense, instant, 18 s cooldown, spends 25 Fury. For 4 s you take 25% less damage. Opportunity cost: 25 Fury is most of a Bloodthirst (30), and you cannot cast it below 25 Fury. Pairing it with Frenzy (which adds 10% damage taken) offsets part of Frenzy's risk. It reduces damage only; it is not invulnerability.

bk_pummel.name: Pummel
bk_pummel.desc: Off-GCD melee interrupt: windup 0.12 s, recovery 0.18 s, 12 s cooldown. Needs actual contact with an enemy within 2.4 m. Interrupts the target's cast and locks it out for 3 s, and adds +8 Fury. Trade-off: it costs no Fury, but on an enemy that is not casting it only yields the Fury for a 12 s cooldown.

dm_blizzard_burst.name: Blizzard Burst
dm_blizzard_burst.desc: 1.4 s cast, 8 s cooldown, costs 10% max mana, range 28 m. Frost burst centered on the target: up to 5 enemies within 4.5 m take 15-20 Frost damage (Spell Power coefficient 0.12) and are chilled 20% slower for 5 s. Adds +1 Ice Mark and returns 4% mana. Trade-off: a long cast for only +1 Ice Mark; Frost Spike gives +2 Ice Marks and 28% mana back on one target.

dm_umbral_nova.name: Umbral Nova
dm_umbral_nova.desc: Instant, 6 s cooldown, spends 3 Ember and 10% max mana, range 28 m. Shadow release centered on the target: up to 5 enemies within 4.5 m take 34-42 Shadow damage (Spell Power coefficient 0.3) and you recover 4% mana. Trade-off: Void Pulse (also 3 Ember) deals 50-60 to one target on a 4 s cooldown, so Nova only pays off against roughly 2 or more enemies.

dm_frost_ward.name: Frost Ward
dm_frost_ward.desc: Off-GCD defense, instant, 18 s cooldown, spends 2 Ice Mark. Grants an absorb shield of 7% (absorb_pct 0.07) for 6 s. Opportunity cost: the 2 Ice Marks would otherwise shorten your next two fire casts by 30% each, and you must hold 2 Ice Marks to cast it. It absorbs damage only; it is not invulnerability.

dm_scorch.name: Scorch
dm_scorch.desc: Instant, 6 s cooldown, costs 8% max mana, range 28 m. Deals 10-14 Fire damage (Spell Power coefficient 0.15) plus an 8 s burn of 5 Fire damage every 2 s, and adds +1 Ember. It has no cast time, so it neither uses nor spends Ice Marks. Trade-off: about 34 total damage for 8% mana is far below Flame Bolt, so it is the option for moving or for keeping Ember flowing while Ice Marks are held.

el_riptide_ring.name: Riptide Ring
el_riptide_ring.desc: 0.9 s cast, 10 s cooldown, costs 6% max mana. Needs a live enemy within 10 m. Water ring centered on you: up to 5 enemies within 4.5 m take 15-19 Water damage (Spell Power coefficient 0.1) and gain Wet (15% slower, 8 s). Adds +2 Tide. Trade-off: it is self-centered, so you must stand near the pack, with a longer cast and cooldown than Surge, which is ranged but adds only +1 Tide.

el_overload.name: Overload
el_overload.desc: 1.5 s cast, 12 s cooldown, spends 4 Tide and 12% max mana, range 28 m. Deals 74-88 Lightning damage (Spell Power coefficient 0.5), 25% more against Wet targets, and grants Return for 5 s so the next Water Bolt casts at half time. Opportunity cost: 4 of your 5 Tide, enough for two Lightning bolts (30-38 each), so use it when Wet is up and you can hold the Tide.

el_static_snare.name: Static Snare
el_static_snare.desc: 0.5 s cast, 24 s cooldown, spends 1 Tide and 5% max mana, range 24 m. Deals 6-9 Lightning damage (Spell Power coefficient 0.08). If the target is Wet it is rooted for 2.5 s; if it is not Wet it is slowed 25% for 3 s instead. Bosses are immune to the root (hard control) and take only the damage. Trade-off: you must set up Wet with Water Bolt or Surge first, and the 24 s cooldown is long.

el_sea_mist.name: Sea Mist
el_sea_mist.desc: Off-GCD group utility, instant, 22 s cooldown, spends 1 Tide and 3% max mana. For 6 s allies within 10 m move 10% faster and take 6% less damage. Opportunity cost: the Tide is half a Lightning, and the effect is small, so it is for repositioning and soak windows rather than raw safety.

wh_dawn_bloom.name: Dawn Bloom
wh_dawn_bloom.desc: 1.2 s cast, 14 s cooldown, spends 2 Bloom and 10% max mana. Allies within 10 m receive Dawn Bloom for 9 s: every 3 s they heal for 2% of max Health, and each effective healing tick also restores 0.6% of your max mana (caster_power_pct_on_heal). Opportunity cost: 2 of your 3 Bloom, so Pure Light (which needs 3 for its discount) is delayed until you rebuild. It only heals over time, so it is wrong against burst damage.

wh_sanctuary_veil.name: Sanctuary Veil
wh_sanctuary_veil.desc: Off-GCD group shield, instant, 28 s cooldown, costs 8% max mana. Allies within 8 m gain an absorb shield of 5% (absorb_pct 0.05) for 6 s. Trade-off: it heals nothing and builds no Bloom, so it must be cast before damage lands: use heals reactively and this one proactively.

wh_sunlit_flash.name: Sunlit Flash
wh_sunlit_flash.desc: 0.6 s cast, no cooldown, costs 10% max mana, range 24 m. Heals the target for 9% of max Health. Trade-off versus Wind Mend (1.1 s cast, 4% mana, 10% heal and +1 Bloom on an effective heal): Flash is nearly twice as fast but costs 2.5 times the mana and builds no Bloom.

wh_zephyr_hush.name: Zephyr Hush
wh_zephyr_hush.desc: Off-GCD interrupt, instant, 20 s cooldown, costs 3% max mana, range 24 m. Interrupts the target's cast and locks it out for 3 s. Opportunity cost: the 20 s cooldown and the attention it takes away from healing; save it for casts that would otherwise force emergency healing.

cl_hammer_sweep.name: Hammer Sweep
cl_hammer_sweep.desc: Melee sweep with the two-handed mace: windup 0.22 s, recovery 0.3 s, 5 s cooldown. Needs a live enemy within 2.4 m. Hits up to 5 enemies within 3.2 m for 15-20 flat Physical damage (no weapon scaling), adds +7 Light and +7 Bolt once, and carries threat bonus 40. Trade-off: Holy Mace gives +12 Light, +12 Bolt and threat bonus 55 on one target; Sweep gives less of each but spreads damage and threat.

cl_thunder_nova.name: Thunder Nova
cl_thunder_nova.desc: Committed lightning slam: windup 0.36 s, recovery 0.4 s, spends 50 Bolt and 50 Light, no cooldown. Needs the two-handed mace, Thunder Brand active (it consumes the Brand) and a live enemy within 2.4 m. Hits up to 5 enemies within 4.5 m for 36-44 flat Lightning damage, carries threat bonus 70 and grants Afterglow for 6 s, which lowers Light Guard and Radiant Mend costs as after Lightning Smash. Trade-off: Lightning Smash costs 40 Bolt and 40 Light for 48-58 on one target; Nova costs 10 more of each and wins against about 2 or more enemies.

cl_storm_ward.name: Storm Ward
cl_storm_ward.desc: Off-GCD defense, instant, 16 s cooldown, spends 25 Bolt. For 4 s you take 20% less damage. Trade-off: this is the Bolt-side counterpart of Light Guard (30 Light, 15% less damage and a party absorb): it protects only you, but lets you defend without draining the Light that Radiant Mend needs. It reduces damage only; it is not invulnerability.

cl_silencing_clap.name: Silencing Clap
cl_silencing_clap.desc: Off-GCD interrupt, instant, 12 s cooldown, spends 15 Light, enemy within 5 m. Interrupts the target's cast and locks it out for 3 s. Opportunity cost: the Light competes with Radiant Mend and Light Guard, so keep at least 15 Light spare before engaging casters.

as_fan_of_knives.name: Fan of Knives
as_fan_of_knives.desc: Melee flurry: windup 0.2 s, recovery 0.26 s, 6 s cooldown, costs 35 Energy. Needs dual daggers and a live enemy within 2.4 m. Hits up to 5 enemies within 3.5 m for 15-20 flat Physical damage (no weapon scaling), applies Poison to each (as exported: 12 s, 4 Nature damage every 3 s regardless of Bleed; the 5 Energy returned to you per tick requires the as_bleed aura on that target; dispellable) and adds +1 combo point. Trade-off: 35 Energy for 1 combo point is poor value on one target compared with Backstab (25 Energy, 2 combo points); it exists to spread Poison over a pack.

as_hamstring.name: Hamstring
as_hamstring.desc: Melee cut: windup 0.14 s, recovery 0.2 s, 8 s cooldown, costs 20 Energy. Needs dual daggers and a live enemy within 2.4 m. Weapon strike for 30% weapon damage +4, adds +1 combo point and slows the target 30% for 5 s. Trade-off: it is a weaker builder than Venomous Cut (65% weapon damage +6 and Poison) with an 8 s cooldown, so it is for keeping a runner in reach, not for damage.

as_evasive_veil.name: Evasive Veil
as_evasive_veil.desc: Off-GCD defense, instant, 20 s cooldown, costs 20 Energy. For 4 s you take 20% less damage and move 10% faster. Opportunity cost: 20 Energy is almost a Venomous Cut, which delays your next finisher. It reduces damage only; it is not invulnerability.

as_kick.name: Kick
as_kick.desc: Off-GCD melee interrupt: windup 0.12 s, recovery 0.18 s, 12 s cooldown, costs 15 Energy. Needs dual daggers and an enemy within 2.4 m. Interrupts the target's cast and locks it out for 3 s. Opportunity cost: it builds no combo points, so each use costs 15 Energy of builder tempo.

ms_crescent_flurry.name: Crescent Flurry
ms_crescent_flurry.desc: Rapier sweep: windup 0.2 s, recovery 0.26 s, 6 s cooldown. Needs a rapier and a live enemy within 2.4 m. Hits up to 4 enemies in a frontal 3.2 m arc for 15-20 flat Physical damage (no weapon scaling) and adds +10 Resonance, plus another +8 Resonance if Shadow Edge is active (which it consumes). Trade-off: unlike Arcane Edge it does not grant Echo, so it is the multi-target Resonance builder but gives up the instant Shadow Bolt that Echo provides.

ms_counter_thrust.name: Counter Thrust
ms_counter_thrust.desc: Off-GCD defensive timing window: instant, 9 s cooldown. Needs a rapier. For 0.5 s after use, an incoming melee hit is answered with a riposte for 22-28 damage, a 0.5 s stun (bosses are immune to stun) and +15 Resonance. The riposte effect carries weapon rapier; the receiving integrator is assumed to supply guard support that honors it (not verifiable standalone). Opportunity cost: if nothing triggers it, nothing happens and the 9 s cooldown is spent, so it rewards reading enemy windups.

ms_dusk_chain.name: Dusk Chain
ms_dusk_chain.desc: 0.75 s cast (instant while Echo is active, which it consumes), 8 s cooldown, spends 35 Resonance, range 16 m. Needs a rapier. Shadow bolt for 20-26 damage (Attack Power coefficient 0.1) that chains up to 2 jumps to enemies within 5 m for 16-20 each, with falloff 0.3 per jump. Trade-off: it gives no Shadow Edge and no Resonance, and its 35 Resonance competes with Spellblade (needs 30) and Unbound (60).

ms_disrupting_thrust.name: Disrupting Thrust
ms_disrupting_thrust.desc: Off-GCD thrust interrupt: windup 0.12 s, recovery 0.18 s, 14 s cooldown, enemy within 3 m. Needs a rapier. Interrupts the target's cast and locks it out for 2.5 s, then adds +8 Resonance. The lock is shorter and the cooldown longer than other jobs' interrupts, in exchange for the Resonance.

cannon_suppressing_fire.name: Suppressing Fire
cannon_suppressing_fire.desc: Ranged volley: windup 0.2 s, recovery 0.26 s, 8 s cooldown, spends 1 Ammo, range 28 m. Needs a ranged weapon. Hits up to 5 enemies within 4 m of the target for 15-20 flat Physical damage (Ranged Attack Power coefficient 0.05), slows them 25% for 4 s and adds +1 Aim. Trade-off: low damage for a round, so it is a control and Aim tool; Barrage deals 22-28 to the same pack for 2 Ammo and 2 Aim.

cannon_ricochet.name: Ricochet Shot
cannon_ricochet.desc: Ranged shot: windup 0.2 s, recovery 0.28 s, 6 s cooldown, spends 1 Ammo and 1 Aim, range 28 m. Needs a ranged weapon. Fires at one target for 45% ranged weapon damage +6 (Ranged Attack Power coefficient 0.05), then ricochets for 14-18 damage to up to 2 more enemies within 5 m of the previous hit (falloff 0.3). Trade-off: it spends Aim that Burst and Barrage need (2 each) and adds no Aim itself, unlike Steady Shot.

cannon_brace.name: Braced Stance
cannon_brace.desc: Off-GCD stance, instant, 14 s cooldown, spends 1 Ammo. Needs a ranged weapon. For 4 s you take 20% less damage but move 40% slower, so you hold position instead of kiting. Opportunity cost: 1 Ammo from a six-round magazine and the loss of mobility; Recoil is the movement answer to the same pressure. It reduces damage only; it is not invulnerability.

cannon_speed_load.name: Speed Load
cannon_speed_load.desc: 0.6 s channel, 6 s cooldown, spends 1 Aim. Needs a ranged weapon and at most 4 Ammo. Quick reload that adds +2 Ammo (Reload adds +3 over a 1.2 s channel with no cooldown). You can move at 60% speed while loading. Opportunity cost: it burns 1 Aim, which delays Burst and Barrage, and it tops up less than a full reload; you must hold 1 Aim to use it.

mech_flak_burst.name: Flak Burst
mech_flak_burst.desc: Ranged blast: windup 0.18 s, recovery 0.26 s, 5 s cooldown, range 16 m. Needs Mech Armor active and at most 78 Heat. Hits up to 5 enemies within 4 m of the target for 18-24 flat Physical damage (Ranged Attack Power coefficient 0.06) and adds +20 Heat. Trade-off: the Heat is the price; from empty you get about 4 casts before you must vent, and it competes with Rocket (+24 Heat, one target) and Rail (60 Heat).

mech_coolant_spray.name: Coolant Spray
mech_coolant_spray.desc: Frontal spray: windup 0.16 s, recovery 0.24 s, 8 s cooldown. Needs Mech Armor, at least 15 Heat and a live enemy within 5 m. Hits up to 5 enemies in a frontal 5 m cone for 15-20 flat Frost damage (no weapon scaling), slows them 25% for 4 s and removes 15 Heat. Trade-off: Vent removes 30 Heat but is a 1.2 s channel with no damage; Spray cools half as much on an 8 s cooldown, but you keep fighting and hit the whole pack.

mech_shield_projector.name: Shield Projector
mech_shield_projector.desc: Off-GCD group defense, instant, 20 s cooldown. Needs Mech Armor and at most 80 Heat. For 5 s allies within 6 m take 10% less damage, and you gain +16 Heat. Opportunity cost: 16 Heat is almost a Piston strike's 18 and can push you above the Heat limits of Rocket and Overdrive. It reduces damage only; it is not invulnerability.
mech_shield_projector.rotation_role: Group defensive cooldown paid in Heat

mech_static_pulse.name: Static Pulse
mech_static_pulse.desc: Off-GCD interrupt, instant, 14 s cooldown, range 14 m. Needs Mech Armor and at most 85 Heat. Interrupts the target's cast, locks it out for 2.5 s and adds +12 Heat. Opportunity cost: the Heat, which you would otherwise spend on Rocket or Rail.

paladin.decision_notes: Loop: Oath Cut (+1 Holy Power, grants Oath) then Shield Bash (+2 with Oath), then spend. Decisions: against one target spend 3 Holy Power on Radiant Strike (36-44 plus Resolve, bonus after a riposte); against a pack either keep building with Sweeping Oath (+1, 4 targets, but no Oath so Bash loses its bonus) or save the whole bar for Hallowed Verdict (5 Holy Power, 5 targets, self-heal). Defensive spending competes with offense: Guard costs 1, Bastion Ward costs 2 and slows allies 12%, Holy Bulwark costs no Holy Power but has a long cooldown. Rebuke is free and off-GCD; its only cost is staying within 3 m of a caster. Opportunity cost is always Holy Power: every point spent on protection delays the next Radiant Strike by roughly one builder.

berserker.decision_notes: Loop: Rend Slash builds Fury (+12, +6 with Flow), Bloodthirst (30 Fury) grants Flow and heals, then an enhanced Rend Slash. Decisions: with 3 or more enemies swap Rend Slash for Reaping Cleave (+8 Fury, weaker but 5 targets) and Bloodthirst for Blood Cyclone (40 Fury, 5 targets, still grants Flow so the loop continues). Execute (50 Fury) stays the single-target finisher. Defense is paid in Fury: Gritted Teeth costs 25 Fury, nearly a Bloodthirst, and pairs with Frenzy's 10% extra damage taken. Pummel is free but needs contact and gives only +8 Fury. Opportunity cost is Fury tempo: every defensive or AoE swap delays the next Bloodthirst or Execute.

dark_mage.decision_notes: Loop: ice builds Ice Marks and mana, fire casts each consume one Ice Mark to cast 30% faster and build Ember, Void Pulse spends 3 Ember. Decisions: Blizzard Burst is the pack Ice Mark builder (+1, slow) but weaker than Frost Spike on one target; Umbral Nova replaces Void Pulse against 2 or more enemies; Scorch is the instant option while moving but ignores Ice Marks. Frost Ward spends 2 Ice Marks, which are exactly two discounted fire casts, so defense directly slows the fire phase. Opportunity cost is Ice Marks and Ember: every mark spent on Ward is a 30%-faster Flame Bolt not cast, and every 3 Ember spent on Nova is a single-target Void Pulse not cast.

elementalist.decision_notes: Loop: water applies Wet and builds Tide, lightning spends Tide for bonus damage on Wet targets and grants Return, Return halves the next Water Bolt cast and gives extra Tide. Decisions: Riptide Ring (+2 Tide, self-centered) versus Surge (+1 Tide, ranged); Overload (4 Tide) versus two Lightning bolts or one Thunderstorm; Static Snare only roots a Wet target and only slows otherwise, so it rewards keeping Wet up and adds nothing against bosses' hard-control immunity. Sea Mist and Tide Shield are defensive and cost Tide. Opportunity cost is Tide: it is capped at 5, and every defensive or control point is a Lightning not cast.

radiant.decision_notes: Loop: Water Blessing then Wind Mend (bonus on blessed targets, +1 Bloom per effective heal) build Bloom to 3, which makes Pure Light cheap and fast. Decisions: spend 2 Bloom on Dawn Bloom (group heal over time, 9 s) or hold 3 for Pure Light (single big heal) or 1 for Luminous Wave; Sunlit Flash is the emergency heal that costs 10% mana and builds no Bloom; Sanctuary Veil is mana-only prevention cast before a hit; Zephyr Hush trades a 20 s cooldown and healing attention for stopping a cast. Opportunity cost is Bloom and mana: Bloom caps at 3, so Dawn Bloom always delays Pure Light, and Flash drains mana that the efficient loop saves.

shadow_priest.decision_notes: Loop: Holy Mace builds Light and Bolt evenly, Thunder Brand (20 Bolt) enables a 40/40 Lightning Smash that grants Afterglow, Afterglow lowers the cost of Light Guard and Radiant Mend. Decisions: Hammer Sweep (+7/+7, 5 targets) instead of Holy Mace on packs; Thunder Nova (50/50, 5 targets, consumes Brand, grants Afterglow) instead of Smash on packs. Defense splits by gauge: Light Guard and Radiant Mend spend Light, Storm Ward spends Bolt, Silencing Clap spends 15 Light. Gauge Exchange and the focus buffs still steer which gauge fills. Opportunity cost: every gauge point spent on defense or interrupts delays the Brand-Smash cycle, and Nova costs 10 more of each gauge than Smash.

assassin.decision_notes: Loop: Venomous Cut (Poison, +1 combo, +1 more with Edge) and Backstab (+2 combo) build combo points, Death Mark applies Bleed, which Poison needs to return Energy on its ticks, Envenom spends combos and grants Edge. Decisions: Fan of Knives (35 Energy, +1 combo) spreads Poison to up to 5 enemies and is poor value on one target; Hamstring (20 Energy) keeps a runner slowed 30% but is a weak builder; Evasive Veil (20 Energy) and Kick (15 Energy) are off-GCD answers that cost builder tempo. Opportunity cost is Energy: every defensive or utility use is a Venomous Cut or Backstab not cast, so the next finisher arrives later.

duelist.decision_notes: Loop: Shadow Bolt (+20 Resonance, grants Shadow Edge) then Arcane Edge (bonus with Edge, +10, grants Echo), Echo makes the next Shadow Bolt instant, Unbound spends 60 Resonance, Spellblade needs 30. Decisions: Crescent Flurry builds Resonance on up to 4 enemies but grants no Echo; Dusk Chain (35 Resonance) chains Shadow damage through up to 3 enemies and is instant under Echo, competing with Spellblade (30) and Unbound (60); Counter Thrust is a 0.5 s riposte window that refunds Resonance only if the enemy hits you; Disrupting Thrust gives +8 Resonance with a shorter lock. Opportunity cost: Resonance spent on Chain is not available for Unbound or Spellblade, and a missed Counter Thrust window is a lost 9 s cooldown.

marksman.decision_notes: Loop: Steady builds Aim (1 Ammo, +1 Aim), Burst and Barrage spend 2 Ammo and 2 Aim, the six-round magazine forces a manual Reload (+3 Ammo, 1.2 s). Decisions: Suppressing Fire (1 Ammo, +1 Aim, slow, 5 targets) as a pack Aim builder; Ricochet (1 Ammo, 1 Aim) spreads damage through up to 3 targets; Speed Load (0.6 s, +2 Ammo) for a faster top-up that burns 1 Aim; Braced Stance (1 Ammo) trades mobility for 20% less damage, whereas Recoil is the movement answer. Opportunity cost: Ammo is the hard cap (6), so every Brace or extra volley brings the next reload forward, and Aim spent on Ricochet or Speed Load delays Burst and Barrage.

gadgeteer.decision_notes: Loop: Piston and Rocket raise Heat (+18, +24) with bonus damage above 50 Heat, Rail spends 60 Heat and grants Cooled for an extra Piston hit, Vent (-30 Heat) is the active release, all gated by Mech Armor and Heat ceilings. Decisions: Flak Burst (+20 Heat, 5 targets) replaces Rocket on packs; Coolant Spray (-15 Heat, 5 targets, slow) lets you cool while still dealing damage; Shield Projector (+16 Heat) and Static Pulse (+12 Heat) are group defense and interrupt paid in Heat, and each can push you above the ceiling of Rocket, Piston or Overdrive. Opportunity cost is Heat headroom: every defensive or utility use shortens the safe window before a Vent, and a mistimed one forces a 1.2 s Vent channel.
